title: Morning Brief — Monday, 26 October 2026
description: The Kangaroos survive a scare to beat Fiji at the Rugby League World Cup, Queensland's latest crime statistics show assault offences continuing to fall, and the Gold Coast council adopts a broader disaster management plan covering cyber attacks and terrorism. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
